Select any combination of original, protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia. One view fills the area; multiple views appear side by side in a grid, for both live camera and imported images.

Uses the Machado, Oliveira and Fernandes (2009) approximation at full severity in linear sRGB. It cannot reproduce every individual’s vision or provide a diagnosis.

Images and camera frames stay on the device. Imported images are sampled to a maximum edge of 2048 pixels. PNG export includes the selected views in the current layout, with a maximum edge of 2048 pixels, without overwriting the source. Leaving the app closes the camera. Cloud file providers may use their own network access.

Matrices reference the MIT-licensed DaltonLens implementation; its license is bundled. Paper: A Physiologically-based Model for Simulation of Color Vision Deficiency, IEEE TVCG 15(6), 2009. DOI: 10.1109/TVCG.2009.113. Implementation: https://github.com/DaltonLens/DaltonLens-Python
